input_channels.order: one-hot(4) | orf_track(5) | rna_coverage(1); coverage is ALWAYS last
input_channels.onehot_note: U maps to the T column; N or any other character is an all-zero row
input_channels.rna_coverage_transform: log1p(coverage / global_mean_coverage)  [cov_norm=global_mean]. Per-nt RNA depth divided by the PACK's own global mean before log1p, so the channel is depth-normalised and comparable across datasets.

body.block: residual: x + drop(conv2(gelu(norm2(conv1(gelu(norm1(x)))))))-style, two k=3 dilated convs per block
body.receptive_field_derivation: 1 + 2*(k-1)*sum(dilations) = 1 + 4*1023 = 4093. Two k=3 convs per block, each widening by 2*d; in_proj is k=1 and adds nothing.
body.receptive_field_caveat: THIS IS THE CONVOLUTIONAL RECEPTIVE FIELD ONLY. The mixer below is FULL self-attention over the transcript, masked for padding alone (`self.attn(xt, src_key_padding_mask=~mask)`) -- no causal and no local window. So the attn model's EFFECTIVE context is the ENTIRE transcript, not 4093 nt. Labelling the panel 'receptive field ~4 kb' without this qualifier understates the attn model. Say 'convolutional receptive field 4,093 nt; attention is global over the transcript'.

mixer_cfg.d_ff_note: dim_feedforward = channels * 2, not an independent hyperparameter
mixer_cfg.attention_scope: global over the transcript; only padding is masked

profile.activation: log_softmax over positions, applied at loss time

count.input: masked mean of body features over valid positions, CONCATENATED with log1p(total RNA coverage) for the transcript

loss.profile: per-transcript multinomial NLL, equal-weighted across transcripts
loss.peakiness_note: 0.0 in the deployed model; the entropy-gap anti-smoothing term is an A/B arm, not part of this checkpoint

data.kozak: none (heuristic Kozak gate DROPPED; see docs/PIPELINE_POLICY.md)
